outputRules: A game image is data for an emulator; it is never relabeled or converted into a native .exe, .dll, Linux executable or WASM module.
Native executables and browser artifacts are built from source code, emulator projects or homebrew source, not from proprietary game binaries.
DLL/.so outputs require a project-defined library/plugin ABI; none of the audited console input formats defines that ABI.
Keep input images, WADs, keys, IPL/BIOS and title data operator-provided and out of distributable build artifacts.

graphicsPolicy.windowsGecko: Native wgpu renderer enumerates available backends and honors WGPU_BACKEND=dx12; default environment selection remains driver/platform dependent.
graphicsPolicy.windowsDolphin: Dolphin's Win32 CMake source includes the D3D12 video backend; the user selects D3D12 in the emulator graphics settings.
graphicsPolicy.web: Gecko browser crate pins wgpu::Backends::BROWSER_WEBGPU; WGPU_BACKEND cannot switch browser rendering to native D3D12.
graphicsPolicy.qualification: A successful compile confirms backend code is present; actual D3D12/WebGPU adapter creation and rendering require runtime qualification on the respective host/browser.
